messages:
ana (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — launching the SI Microlearning Champion program (pilot wave 1). Goal: certify 8 SI champions by EoQ2 to support joint marketplace listings. Need ops, training, and field handoff defined. Who can own schedule + content slice?

zara (Enablement): I can own curriculum and assessments. thinking 4 micro-modules (30m each) + short cert quiz.

liam (SI PM): I'll coordinate SI invites and get sign-off from two partners (VertexSI, Argos Integrations). target cohort start: 2 weeks.

jess (Training): Proposed delivery: async videos + 2 live office hours. sample cadence: `1 cohort / week x 4 weeks` or condensed `2 cohorts / month` depending on demand.

sam (Field): Need a one-pager for Field handoff: who to contact post-cert, preferred escalation path, and a quick win playbook (1-2 integrations). I'll draft.

zara (Enablement): +1 to a one-pager. also want a lightweight badge we can link in partner portals.

ana (typo) — remove.

ana? (This line intentionally left to show human typo)

ana (Partnerships): edited: ignore the accidental message above.

devops-bot: course assets deployed to s3://redwood-si-learning/pilot-wave1 at 2024-11-03T15:22Z. preview links: https://dl.redwood.ai/pilot1/overview

jess (Training): Content checklist: 1) Quickstart lab (VM + REDWOOD_API_KEY env), 2) cost/latency playbook, 3) troubleshooting KB, 4) certification quiz (10 Qs).

liam (SI PM): Action items: - zara: curriculum by 11/10 - jess: record async vids by 11/15 - sam: one-pager draft by 11/12 - partnerships (ana): partner invites + comms by 11/13. I'll own partner RSVP tracking.

ana (Partnerships): small ask: include a joint-announcement checklist for marketplace listings (legal + PR + launch window). I'll loop in legal.

zara (Enablement): For assessments want pass threshold = 80%. open to making re-takes limited to 2.

sam (Field): Will prepare 2 quick-win integration examples: batch embedding index + real-time chat fallback.

jess (Training): Office hours schedule: Thu 13:00 PST and Mon 09:00 PST. I'll add calendar invites after vids are uploaded.

liam (SI PM): Noting logistics: need test accounts for partners. @devops-bot can you provision 8 trial seats (30 days) scoped to partner orgs?

devops-bot: Provision request queued: `provision_trials --count 8 --ttl 30d --scope si-pilot`. ETA 2h.

ana (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. We'll do a dry run next Tue 11/21 10:00 PT — jess, zara, liam please join. I'll post calendar invite. :thumbsup: 

zara (Enablement): ACK.

jess (Training): ACK.

liam (SI PM): ACK — will bring RSVP tracking sheet and partner contact list.

sam (Field): will share one-pager draft in this thread when ready.

ana (Partnerships): Closing note: want a short feedback survey at end of pilot to measure readiness and preferred support model. I'll prototype a 5-question survey.

(THREAD END)
